title: Ensuring Security in Light of Recent Terrorist Attacks
what_it_is: Ensuring Security in Light of Recent Terrorist Attacks

sections.label: Jakarta bombing and security questions
sections.summary: Questions asked the Minister for Home Affairs about stepping up border and internal security and increasing vigilance after the Jakarta bombing and global terrorist incidents.

sentences.speaker: Mr Christopher de Souza
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs in light of the 14 January 2016 bombing in Jakarta, what is being done to (i) step up Singapore's border security and internal security and (ii) increase the vigilance of Singaporeans, the resident population and the Home Team.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira
sentences.text: asked	the Minister for Home Affairs in view of the number of terrorist incidents globally and Singapore's status as a travel hub, what new measures are put in place to ensure our domestic security while maintaining our lead as a travel destination and attraction.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Home Affairs (Mr Desmond Lee) (for the Minister for Home Affairs)
sentences.text: So, if Mdm Speaker would permit, I would like to answer Question Nos 1 and 2 together.

sections.label: Southeast Asians joining ISIS
sections.summary: Regional authorities estimate that some 1,000 Southeast Asians may have travelled to Syria and Iraq to fight for ISIS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Regional authorities estimate that some 1,000 Southeast Asians may have travelled to Syria and Iraq to fight for ISIS.

sections.label: Indonesian and Malaysian ISIS arrests
sections.summary: Indonesian and Malaysian authorities have collectively arrested over 100 of their citizens for ISIS-related activities and thwarted several planned attacks.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The Indonesian and Malaysian authorities have collectively arrested over 100 of their citizens for ISIS-related activities and thwarted several planned attacks in their own countries.

sections.label: Singaporeans joining ISIS in Syria
sections.summary: At least two Singapore citizens are known to have made their way to Syria with their families to take part in the conflict there.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Ms Tin also asked whether there have been further reports of Singaporeans intending to join ISIS.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So far, at least two Singapore citizens are known to have made their way to Syria with their families to take part in the conflict there.

sections.label: Police cameras and security exercise
sections.summary: Installation of police cameras at all HDB blocks and multi-storey carparks will be completed this year, and over 1,800 Home Team officers joined a security exercise on 19 January 2016.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: The installation of police cameras at all HDB blocks and multi-storey carparks will be completed by this year, and we will look into installing more cameras in HDB estates and other public areas.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In fact, more than 1,800 Home Team officers participated in a multi-agency security exercise on the night of 19 January 2016 to test our contingency and security response plans during a terrorist attack.

sections.label: Strengthening community vigilance and resilience
sections.summary: In the coming months, the Ministry of Home Affairs will work with partners to further strengthen community vigilance, cohesion and resilience.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: In the coming months, the Ministry of Home Affairs (MHA) will be working with our partners to further strengthen our community vigilance, cohesion and resilience.

sections.label: Police cameras rollout estates
sections.summary: Police cameras have been rolled out and will be rolled out across estates by the end of this year.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As I said earlier, Police cameras have been rolled out and will be rolled out by the end of this year across our estates.

sections.label: Building operators in SSWG clusters
sections.summary: As of last December, about 1,300-plus building operators have participated in SSWG clusters.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As of last December, there are about 1,300-plus building operators that have participated in our SSWG clusters.

sections.label: Screening at checkpoints
sections.summary: At checkpoints, 100% or close to 100% screening is done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: As far as checkpoints are concerned, we do 100% or close to 100% screening at our checkpoints.

sections.label: Technology, training and Home Team readiness
sections.summary: Technology augments Home Team capabilities, alongside training, equipping and exercises, so the Forces remain prepared and on top of the risk.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: Amongst other things, leveraging on technology will help augment our Home Team's capabilities to help create new capabilities that were not existent before technology had advanced to that level.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: All these things need to be done but on top of that, good training, proper equipping, constant exercises – both planned as well as unplanned exercises that you spring a surprise on the Forces and you test them, and continually learning from the lessons that we pick up from these exercises – need to be done.

sentences.speaker: Mr Desmond Lee
sentences.text: So, our Forces will be prepared, they have to be, and need to remain on top of the risk.
